ambiguities.text: The exact values of GAS_IDENTITY and GAS_IDENTITY_WORD constants are not explicitly stated in the specification
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM values: GAS_IDENTITY = 15, GAS_IDENTITY_WORD = 3. This needs verification against the actual implementation.

ambiguities.text: Behavior with zero-length input data is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume empty input results in empty output with only GAS_IDENTITY base cost charged (word_count = 0).

implicit_assumptions.description: The identity precompile is deterministic and has no side effects beyond gas consumption
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-deterministic behavior would break consensus across nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Linear gas cost scaling prevents economic denial-of-service via large data copies
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced large data operations could be exploited for resource exhaustion

implicit_assumptions.description: Callers understand that the identity precompile provides no cryptographic guarantees or validation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Misuse of identity precompile where validation is needed could introduce vulnerabilities
